# routeros_ipv6_dhcp_server_binding (Data Source)


## Example Usage
```terraform

# Omit `filter` to read all of them.

  filter = {
    comment = "managed by terraform"

  value = data.routeros_ipv6_dhcp_server_binding.example.entries[*].id
}
```
